description: Task-specific designs: coagulation variable for size, log1p(aging) for detector response

model.formula: y_j = ridge(material one-hot + ln(1 + K N0 t) + no_flow + 5(Rt/R0-1.35)), K N0 = 3.75e-3/s (x0.1 no-flow); Dg, AMD via Hatch-Choate; detection: logit P_j = material + log1p(aging)/7 + no_flow + 5(Rt/R0-1.35), L2 logistic (inner-CV C)
model.notes: Ridge on log Dm, ln sigma_g, log M0; Dg and AMD derived by Hatch-Choate. Per-target alpha by GCV; logistic C by inner 5-fold Brier.
